description: A tuple for expression whose condition is an unknown number for an element gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec requires a bool condition and gives the dynamic value only for unknowns that are otherwise type-valid, so an unknown number condition should be an error. A tuple for expression in hashicorp/hcl checks whether the condition is known before converting it to bool and returns the dynamic value (ForExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go); an object for expression converts first and reports the error (for-object-unknown-number-condition-per-element-fails).
